claims.claim: VOS framework unifies Nesterov and ADMM from continuous-time ODE
claims.evidence: Both derived from X'' + gamma(t)*X' + grad_f(X) = 0 via variable/operator splitting

claims.claim: Nesterov achieves O(1/k^2) convergence for convex objectives
claims.evidence: Convergence curves in fig1_convergence_comparison.png match theoretical rate

claims.claim: Linear convergence for strongly convex objectives via Lyapunov
claims.evidence: Lyapunov decay on quadratic problem (kappa=37.6) matches theoretical rate

claims.claim: sqrt(kappa) improvement of NAG over GD
claims.evidence: GD rate ~0.899/iter vs NAG rate ~0.536/iter on quadratic (kappa=37.6)

claims.claim: Phase transition at r=3 in damping constant
claims.evidence: Theoretical from Su et al. (2015), verified via ODE integration
VOS-ADMM did not converge well (obj=432.4 vs optimal 311.1)
